body: PRE-CANDIDATE SCALA-TYPE/PROVENANCE REVIEW — BLOCK on exact cb63bf08ab8b48a03f9853af21ef5d33c314e3c6 (parent e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a). Two P1 contract defects remain. (1) AcquisitionViewAuthority is still caller-mintable. acquire/output.scala:498-501 exposes plain enum cases carrying public unsafe receipt IDs; AcquisitionAccount.of accepts them; authorityReceipt at :611-633 ignores both human/fixture receipt identities and admits FixtureReview from any constructed source. The codec at codec/output_acquire.scala:632-680 decodes this untrusted label and ID directly back through AcquisitionAccount.of. Existing acquire court :232-249 positively asserts an arbitrary FixtureAdmissionReceiptId is valid. AdmittedViewBasis.fromAcquisition at view/output.scala:765-813 then upgrades that label to ResearcherReviewedFixture/HumanAdjudicated. Relabeling acquisition authority and basis together therefore passes; fromWire only detects disagreement between the two caller-controlled claims. This does not satisfy required repair 1. Replace the label plus receipt-shaped ID with an unforgeable joined authority admitted from actual build/adjudication/fixture evidence, and add a combined relabel mutation court. (2) ReportInputIdentity is not complete. derive/sourceParts/semanticParts at view/output.scala:509-583 omits result fields including OriginalSourceIdentity.intakeReceipt; UniverseFailure.stage; ResultGap.payload; and OutputFailure.stage/evidence. A receipt can therefore cross unequal deterministic results. Verified by an isolated test-only mutation in an exact-commit archive: changing only admitted intakeReceipt produced equal ReportInputIdentity(5f29fd586d71); focused viewJVM OutputSuite failed 1/18 at the new assertion while the original 17 tests passed. This violates required repair 3. Bind canonical bytes for the full AcquisitionAccount and request/config state, or exhaustively include every field with domain separators, then add one-field foreign-result courts for each ADT branch. Verified: exact source, decoder, current courts, and runnable intake-receipt mutant. Inferred from those public constructors: arbitrary human/fixture receipt claims also survive wire decode. Plan reconciliation: repairs 1 and 3 are unmet; repair 2 and the construction-door courts look structurally sound in the inspected slice. Ergonomics: an issuance type should accept real authority evidence, not force callers to assemble parallel labels. No formal candidate exists yet, so this is a pre-registration block and recut request, not a candidate-register review.
